posts.text:
Alan Greenspan was an institution at the Fed and led it through some incredibly eventful times.

He was a devoted public servant and a friend. My heart goes out to @mitchellreports and his family.
posts.summary: Honors Greenspan's Fed leadership during turbulent periods
